# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the complete rule: blue light means cut red wire, green means cut yellow, and red means cut green. I cannot inspect the bomb, so I will wait for Blind to describe its light. Then I can relay the required wire to Deaf using a gesture code agreed from the incoming information.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have no tactile information yet. Read the manual and obtain Deaf's report of every colour and marking, then tell me exactly which wire position to cut and when.
Deaf says to Mute: Display is 0. Light is red. Wires from 1 to 3 are yellow, green, red.

The light is red, so the manual requires cutting the green wire. Deaf reports the wires as yellow, green, red in positions 1–3, making the green wire position 2. I will signal Deaf with the gesture for two so Deaf can tell Blind the exact position.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No tactile markings or wire information are available to me. Please relay the manual rule and Deaf's complete report, including display, light, and wire markings.

Deaf already has the complete bomb report, and my previous gesture identified the required green wire as position 2. I will prompt Deaf to relay the report and the cut position to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "👉"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: cut wire 2, the green wire. What does the manual say? Confirm whether wire 2 is the required cut.

The manual says a red light requires cutting the green wire. Deaf reported that wire 2 is green, so wire 2 is the correct cut. I will confirm this to Deaf, who can relay it verbally to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please speak the manual instruction to me directly. Deaf reports your gestures as two, then right, but I need the exact wire action in words.

I cannot speak directly because I am the Mute. Blind must receive the instruction through Deaf. I will again signal Deaf that wire 2 is confirmed as the correct wire, so Deaf can state the action aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: New bomb: display 0, light blue, wires 1 yellow, 2 CUT, 3 red. Please consult the manual for the next required action.

The bomb has changed. Its blue light requires cutting the red wire, and Deaf reports that the red wire is position 3. I will signal Deaf with the established number gesture for three so Deaf can tell Blind to cut wire 3.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: After cutting wire 2, Deaf reports display 0, blue light, wire 1 yellow, and wire 3 red. Please provide the manual's next instruction and coordinate with Deaf before I act.

The blue light requires cutting the red wire. Deaf’s report places the red wire at position 3, so Blind should cut wire 3. I will send Deaf the established signal for three, with confirmation.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👍"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Deaf says to Mute: New bomb: display 0, light green, wire 1 yellow, wire 2 CUT, wire 3 CUT. Please consult the manual for the next action.

The new light is green, and the manual requires cutting the yellow wire. Deaf reports that wire 1 is yellow, so the next action is to cut wire 1. I will signal Deaf with the established gesture for one.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | red |
| green | yellow |
| red | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The last bomb state required wire 1: the light was green and wire 1 was yellow. I already signaled Deaf with the established gesture for one; there is no new report to relay this turn.

``` 
wait()
```
